operator.name: combineLatestWith
operator.summary: Combine each source value with the latest values from other streams.
operator.behavior: Waits for every input to emit, then emits the latest tuple whenever any input changes.
operator.caution: Every input must emit before the first combined result.

operator.name: concatWith
operator.summary: Continue with other streams after this one completes.
operator.behavior: Subscribes to each subsequent input in order after the previous input completes.
operator.caution: A source that never completes prevents subsequent subscriptions.

operator.name: endWith
operator.summary: Emit final values after successful completion.
operator.behavior: Appends supplied values when the source completes normally.
operator.caution: Final values are not emitted on error or unsubscription.

operator.name: debounce
operator.summary: Wait for a quiet period controlled by another stream.
operator.behavior: Uses a duration selector for each value; a newer value replaces the pending duration.
operator.caution: Return an ObservableInput from the duration selector; use debounceTime for a fixed delay.

operator.name: delay
operator.summary: Delay source values by a time interval.
operator.behavior: Shifts values in time using a delay in milliseconds or a Date.
operator.caution: Errors are forwarded immediately; delay is not a request cancellation mechanism.

operator.name: distinct
operator.summary: Emit only previously unseen values.
operator.behavior: Tracks previously emitted keys for the lifetime of the subscription unless flushed.
operator.caution: The remembered key set can grow indefinitely; distinctUntilChanged only compares consecutive values.

operator.name: scan
operator.summary: Accumulate state on every emission.
operator.behavior: Applies an accumulator and emits each updated state.
operator.caution: Use immutable updates for Angular state. The seed itself is not emitted automatically.

operator.name: reduce
operator.summary: Emit accumulated state when the source completes.
operator.behavior: Applies an accumulator but emits only the final result.
operator.caution: A noncompleting source never emits a final result.

operator.name: timeout
operator.summary: Fail when expected emissions take too long.
operator.behavior: A timeout configuration can limit the first emission or the gap between emissions.
operator.caution: A timeout does not undo server-side work; handle the error or provide a fallback.

operator.name: map
operator.summary: Transform each emitted value.
operator.behavior: Runs the projection for each value; does not subscribe to returned observables.
operator.caution: Use a flattening operator when the projection returns an observable.
operator.parameters: project(value, index): calculate the output for each emission. Returning an observable does not subscribe to it.

operator.name: filter
operator.summary: Keep values matching a predicate.
operator.behavior: Drops nonmatching values; completion and errors still pass through.
operator.caution: A filtered stream may never emit.
operator.parameters: predicate(value, index): return true to keep a value. A type-guard predicate can narrow the output type.

operator.name: tap
operator.summary: Observe notifications for side effects.
operator.behavior: Passes values through unchanged; useful for temporary logging.
operator.caution: Thrown errors terminate the stream; avoid production logging of sensitive values.
operator.parameters: observer or next callback: observe values, errors or completion without transforming emitted values.

operator.name: debounceTime
operator.summary: Wait for a quiet period.
operator.behavior: Emits the latest value after the specified interval without a new value.
operator.caution: Delay is in milliseconds; this does not cancel an already running HTTP request.
operator.parameters: dueTime: quiet period in milliseconds. scheduler: optional scheduler; defaults to asyncScheduler.

operator.name: distinctUntilChanged
operator.summary: Skip consecutive equal values.
operator.behavior: Uses === by default; an optional comparator controls equality.
operator.caution: Objects are compared by reference unless you provide a comparator.
operator.parameters: comparator(previous, current): return true to suppress a value; defaults to ===. keySelector: optional comparison key.

operator.name: switchMap
operator.summary: Keep only the latest inner subscription.
operator.behavior: A new source value unsubscribes from the previous inner observable and subscribes to the next.
operator.caution: Unsubscription cannot undo a server-side write. Consider concatMap or exhaustMap for saves.
operator.parameters: project(value, index): return an ObservableInput for each accepted source value, for example an HTTP request.

operator.name: concatMap
operator.summary: Queue inner observables sequentially.
operator.behavior: Waits for each inner observable to complete before subscribing to the next.
operator.caution: A noncompleting inner stream blocks the queue; a fast source can grow the queue.
operator.parameters: project(value, index): return an ObservableInput for each accepted source value, for example an HTTP request.

operator.name: mergeMap
operator.summary: Run inner observables concurrently.
operator.behavior: Emits results as they arrive; optional concurrency limits active subscriptions.
operator.caution: Results can arrive out of order; long-lived inner subscriptions need cleanup.
operator.parameters: project(value, index): return an ObservableInput. concurrent: maximum active inner subscriptions; defaults to Infinity.

operator.name: exhaustMap
operator.summary: Ignore new work while an inner subscription is active.
operator.behavior: Accepts another source value only after the current inner observable completes.
operator.caution: Ignored source values are discarded, not queued.
operator.parameters: project(value, index): return an ObservableInput for each accepted source value, for example an HTTP request.

operator.name: catchError
operator.summary: Replace a failed stream with another observable.
operator.behavior: The replacement observable takes over; placement controls which subscription survives.
operator.caution: Outside switchMap, recovery can complete the entire query stream after the first failure.
operator.parameters: selector(error, caught): return a replacement ObservableInput or throw an error. Placement determines which stream recovers.

operator.name: retry
operator.summary: Resubscribe after an error.
operator.behavior: Repeats the source subscription according to its retry configuration.
operator.caution: Retries can repeat writes; retrying without a bound can continue indefinitely.

operator.name: finalize
operator.summary: Run cleanup when a subscription ends.
operator.behavior: Runs on completion, error, or explicit unsubscription.
operator.caution: Cleanup also runs when switchMap cancels an inner subscription.

operator.name: first
operator.summary: Emit the first matching value, then complete.
operator.behavior: Without a predicate, emits the first source value. With a predicate, waits for the first match and then unsubscribes.
operator.caution: An empty source or no matching value raises EmptyError unless a default is supplied. Use take(1) when empty completion is acceptable.
operator.parameters: predicate: optional matching condition. defaultValue: optional fallback if no value matches; otherwise an empty source raises EmptyError.

operator.name: take
operator.summary: Complete after a fixed number of values.
operator.behavior: Unsubscribes from the source after the requested number of emissions.
operator.caution: If the source never emits, take(1) alone does not end the subscription.
operator.parameters: count: maximum number of source values to emit; zero completes immediately.

operator.name: takeUntil
operator.summary: Complete when a notifier emits.
operator.behavior: A notifier emission ends the source subscription.
operator.caution: Completing the notifier without emitting does not stop the source.
operator.parameters: notifier: its first emission completes the output. A notifier that only completes does not stop the source.

operator.name: shareReplay
operator.summary: Share a source and replay recent values.
operator.behavior: Subscribers share an upstream subscription and receive buffered emissions.
operator.caution: Choose buffer size and refCount deliberately; cached values can become stale.
operator.parameters: Prefer an explicit configuration: bufferSize controls replay history; refCount controls disconnection when no subscribers remain.

operator.name: startWith
operator.summary: Emit initial values before the source.
operator.behavior: Emits the supplied values on subscription before subscribing to the source.
operator.caution: An initial UI value does not mean the request has completed.

operator.name: combineLatest
operator.summary: Combine the latest values of multiple sources.
operator.behavior: Waits for every input to emit once, then emits whenever any input changes.
operator.caution: One input without an initial emission can prevent any output.

operator.name: forkJoin
operator.summary: Collect the final values of completing sources.
operator.behavior: Emits once after all inputs complete, using their last values.
operator.caution: A noncompleting input prevents output; an empty input can complete without output.

operator.name: of
operator.summary: Emit supplied values and complete.
operator.behavior: Emits each argument synchronously, then completes.
operator.caution: of([1, 2]) emits one array, not two numbers.

operator.name: takeUntilDestroyed
operator.summary: Clean up with Angular's destruction lifecycle.
operator.behavior: Completes the observable when the associated DestroyRef is destroyed.
operator.caution: Import DestroyRef and inject from @angular/core, and takeUntilDestroyed from @angular/core/rxjs-interop. Check your Angular version. Pass DestroyRef explicitly outside an injection context.
operator.parameters: destroyRef: optional in an injection context; supply it explicitly outside one.

operator.name: toSignal
operator.summary: Expose an observable as an Angular signal.
operator.behavior: Subscribes immediately and exposes the most recent value through a signal.
operator.caution: Import from @angular/core/rxjs-interop. Reuse the signal instead of repeatedly calling toSignal. Requires an injection context unless an injector is supplied.

operator.name: AsyncPipe
operator.summary: Consume observable values in a template.
operator.behavior: Subscribes for the view and unsubscribes when destroyed or when the expression changes.
operator.caution: Import AsyncPipe from @angular/common in standalone components. Multiple async bindings can create multiple subscriptions.
